products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory founded in 2020 and described on its site as the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). It operates on a not-for-profit basis and presents itself as a leading global scientific research center focused on making advanced AI accessible and available broadly.

TII's primary AI work centers on the Falcon family of large language models, released under the Apache 2.0 license with UAE-hosted, Middle East data residency and an open-source orientation. The Falcon lineup spans several generations and configurations: Falcon 40B was trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens and described as the first home-grown open-source LLM released with weights for research and commercial use; Falcon 180B carries 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens and has appeared at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models; Falcon 2 11B is described as outperforming Meta's Llama 3 8B and performing on par with Google Gemma 7B as independently verified by Hugging Face Leaderboard. Newer additions include Falcon-H1, which uses a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture and is described as outperforming Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen; Falcon-E; Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open-source State Space Language Model; Falcon Arabic, oriented toward Modern Standard Arabic and dialects; and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model combining vision and language capabilities. TII has also announced a non-profit entity called the Falcon Foundation dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI models and building sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects. A related entity, AI71, launched by ATRC and VentureOne, has run a call for proposals inviting developers to build applications using Falcon 10B.
